verdict.rationale: Jan documents importing existing local GGUF files and running models through llama.cpp. That implies it uses a standard, unconverted model format, so models already on disk can be reused without re-downloading. The evidence only covers the import direction into Jan, though, and says nothing about where Jan stores its downloads or whether other runtimes can use those files and caches directly. Missing for 10: documented model storage location and format, explicit guidance on sharing Jan-downloaded files with other runtimes (e.g. llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio), cache reuse behavior, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether downloaded model files and caches can be reused by other runtimes without re-downloading or re-converting them

citations.quote: From Local Files: Click Import Model and select your GGUF files.
Jan provides a built-in, OpenAI-compatible API server that runs entirely on your computer, powered by `llama.cpp`.
